atomic-chat-conf.note: The backend fixture is exact. The provider fixture is a deterministic representative slice of the pinned registry. recommended-models.json mirrors the two-model onboarding list and runs ahead of the pinned revision: refresh the revision once that manifest lands on main. staff-picks.json is a representative slice covering every optional field, and predates the pinned revision: refresh the revision once the staff-picks manifest is published to main. turboquant-manifest.json is now only the legacy fallback index for the TurboQuant provider, which resolves releases from turboquant-index.json published on the fork's releases.

atomic-chat-model-catalog.note: Reduced deterministic fixtures preserve the pinned output shape without committing the multi-megabyte generated catalog.
